key_insight: AURORA-AI is a closed-loop resource orchestration framework that uses stability-aware control and fairness-aware utility to keep heterogeneous AI systems resilient under drift, bias shocks, and abrupt disruptions.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical way to dynamically allocate compute across models while balancing accuracy, latency, robustness, interpretability, and demographic parity in changing real-world deployments.
method: Combines Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman feedback control with Lyapunov-based stability monitoring.
Optimizes a composite utility over predictive performance, fairness, cost, latency, robustness, and interpretability.
Continuously reallocates computational budget across heterogeneous models in a closed loop.
evidence_signal: In discrete-time stress simulations with demographic bias shocks, concept drift, and black-swan disruptions, AURORA-AI outperformed Static, Round Robin, Greedy, LinUCB, and PPO, recovering immediately from the black-swan event and improving tail utility and demographic parity gaps.
watch_item: The results are simulation-based, so real-world deployment may require careful validation of the utility weights, stability assumptions, and monitoring overhead.
paper_title: Adaptive Utility driven Resource Orchestration for Resilient AI (AURORA-AI)
